title: docs(skills): context-packs.md says an unserved related child is left out, and names what still refuses the call
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgQcf9HpLbcBYPJUfmvnxobG)_

Fixes #37414

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：AI 助手照技能文档写「资料包」时，学到的是现在的真实行为：提问人看不到某个关联对象时，这一段被省略并附一句说明，而不是整次报错。
- 为什么做：属于「AI 资料包」专题的收尾。产品行为已经改成省略，技能文档还在教旧的整次报错。
- 出错会怎样：只改文档文字，不动产品。写错的话助手会学到错误说法，撤回这次改动即可。
- 要你做什么：这是受管的技能文件，需要审批人批准后才能合并。

## What changes

One paragraph of `skills/objectstack-ai/references/context-packs.md`, section "What the caller is not shown, and what `os validate` reports", plus a `patch` changeset for `@objectstack/skills`.

- Before: "A `related` object the caller cannot read at all refuses the whole call (`403 PERMISSION_DENIED`), so list only child objects the pack's audience can read."
- After: a related list is left out when the caller cannot read its object, the same as for its link field or a `where` / `orderBy` field; the list is never named and `notes` carry the one `not_visible` note. The whole-call `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` stays for a `related` object nobody is served (a system object the record tools refuse, one closed to API list reads, one in a disabled package) and for a lookup shown to the caller whose target is such a system object.

The second half is nit N1 of the contract review on the pull request that added this file: the reference names what still refuses.

The file sat at zero headroom on its token-ratchet row (1454), so the growth is paid for in the same file by cutting five restatements. No ceiling moves and no ratchet row is edited.

| Cut | Why it is restatement |
|:--|:--|
| `fields` row: ": the record's own facts" | the row already says "root fields"; the opening paragraph says "fields of the root object" |
| `related` row: ": rows of another object that hang on the record" | the opening paragraph says "child lists that point at the record"; the `related` entry table says "a child object with a reference field ... that points at the root" |
| `body` row: "the one long text the record is about," | the opening paragraph says "one long-text field read as its body" |
| "(the open ones, soonest first)" | restates the example's `where` and `orderBy` above it |
| ", so a caller never learns it" | restates "silent at the tool" in the same sentence |

Dropped with the old sentence: "so list only child objects the pack's audience can read". That advice was the old behaviour's consequence. A pack now answers a narrower audience with a shorter pack.

## Why

`main` leaves out a related child this caller is not served (ADR-0160 D3 "Object level", as amended; `packages/services/service-record-context/src/record-context-tools.ts`, step 4a) and the published skill still taught the whole-call refusal. An assistant that learns context packs from the skill would tell authors to split packs per audience for a refusal that no longer happens.

## Tests

Documentation only: no package source changes, so no package test suite is owed. No ablation: the diff changes no tested behaviour.

Readings for a `skills/**` diff, base `a46efa8c` against head `782a8c45`:

| Reading | Before | After |
|:--|--:|--:|
| `context-packs.md` lines | 111 | 113 |
| `context-packs.md` bytes | 5813 | 5813 |
| `context-packs.md` tokens (ceiling 1454) | 1454 | 1454 |
| All `skills/*/SKILL.md` lines, summed | 4961 | 4961 |
| Bundle total tokens (whole shipped tree) | 299309 | 299309 |

The two extra lines are re-wrapping; the byte count is unchanged.

## Acceptance notes

- Acceptance 1 (the sentence matches step 4a on `main` and cites no behaviour `main` lacks). Read against `record-context-tools.ts` at `a46efa8c`: step 4a refuses a `related` child on the read guard, then on API exposure for a list read (a disabled package's refusal included), each as `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`; a child that passes both and that this caller is not served is added to the left-out set and sets the one `not_visible` note. Step 4c refuses when the read guard refuses the target of a lookup that survived projection, which is a lookup the caller's served schema shows.
- Acceptance 2 (`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` exits 0, no ceiling raised): exit 0; the row reads 1454 of 1454.
- Acceptance 3: both declaration lines are below and in the changeset.
- Not taught, on purpose: step 4c also refuses a lookup target that the published plan does not reach (a fail-closed branch), and step 4a refuses when a definition read fails. Neither is something an author chooses, so neither is in the reference.
- Noted, not changed (outside this card's sentence): the same paragraph's first clause, "a field the caller cannot read carries no value", describes a field the caller's schema shows and field-level security withholds. A field the caller's schema hides has no entry at all and is covered by the same `not_visible` note. The clause is not wrong for the case it names, and the paragraph's "some material is not visible" covers both.
- No generated mirror moves: `context-packs.md` is referenced only by two `SKILL.md` pointers and its ratchet row.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` prints `context-packs.md is 1454 tokens (ceiling 1454; headroom 0)` and exits 0.

Read first, by risk: (1) the rewritten paragraph in `context-packs.md` against step 4a and 4c; (2) the three key-table rows that lost their gloss; (3) the changeset body.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. (no name added)
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (no formatter ran; the repo-wide lint is CI's run)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
